         5                  This particular initiative will

         6       enable Lake Ronkonkoma, which is the largest

        12       this particular lake.  It dates back,

        13       obviously, to precolonial days and has been

        14       one of the major geographic points on Long

        15       Island, dating back to the time when three

        16       different Indian tribes took claim to

        17       different portions of the shoreline.
